task.notes: Approved by the captain on 2026-11-01: the same transition with the truth cut to the E12.5 test's tissue mix, E10.5's chamber-category cells plus 5% of its surrounding cells (the dissection note's few oesophagus-junction cells). It counts for same-scope T1 comparisons together with the whole-E10.5 task, and alone for comparisons across tissue mixes (D2: B0 against the floor). It shares the chamber map with B0's scope step, so for scope it is a premise check, not evidence.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

copy.what: real reference cells at the count rule

b0.what: B0 (feat-009): T1 chamber-only copy plus damped momentum; T2 copy plus damped momentum or bracket interpolation, both in count space

b0_scope.what: T1 chamber-only copy without a shift (B0's composition alone)

b0_lat_dec.what: B0's drawn cells without B0's shift, each moved in the latent space of row E14's count model (scvi-tools SCVI, n_latent 20, gene dispersion, observed library, no batch key, fitted once per fold on the start and reference stages) by B0_DAMPING of its category's mean latent displacement (B0's moved categories), then NB counts sampled at the decoded rate and the real cell's library (vec.latent_extrap, decoded arm)

b0_lat_ratio.what: the same latent move kept on the real cell: its counts edited by the decoder's per-gene mean ratio between the moved and its own latent through vec.core.apply_factors (expected depth kept, zeros kept, held-flat genes 1, log factor clipped at +-log 3; vec.latent_extrap, ratio arm)
